snippet.description:

Nothing fanciful and all I do is to change the lips colour to match my outfit of the day!

Hope you will like this look and do give me your comments and a thumb up if you like this look!

Thank you!

Product List (in order of usage):
Makeup Base: CandyDoll Lavender Pearl Makeup Base
BB Cream: Holika Holika Face2Change White Cushion BB (Summer Use) / Photo Ready Cushion BB (Winter Use)
Loose Powder: Holika Holika Naked Face Illuminating Powder
Brow Powder: DollyWink Brow Powder
Brow Pencil: Bibo Brow Pencil
Brow Mascara: Sweet Sweet Brow Mascara
Highlight: Sephora Eyeshadow (Porcelain)
Contour: CandyDoll Shading Powder
Eyeshadow: Tony Moly Eyeshadow (Pink Beige and Light Brown)
Eyeliner: DollyWink Liquid Eyeliner
Mascara: CoverGirl Full Lash Bloom
Highlight: Tony Moly Blush (Shimmery Light Pink)
Blush: LB Gorgeous Blush
Lipstick: YSL Rouge Pur Couture #52
